title: Kosher Kid Friendly Filipino Chicken Adobo
description: A kid-friendly version of the classic Filipino dish, made with kosher ingredients and a sweet and tangy barbecue sauce, simmered to perfection in a Dutch oven.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the barbecue sauce, vinegar, soy sauce, brown sugar, pepper, and salt to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the sauce to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the chicken to the pot and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 20 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce over rice or noodles.
Garnish with sliced green onions, if desired.
